title: ADR-0006 deterministic workflow wrappers

Proposal, plan, implementation, handoff, transition, validation, state, and ADR mutations must route through deterministic Cartographer workflow wrappers when available instead of prose-only artifact mutation.
ADR-0004 single-writer implementation state
Cartographer implementation should keep the parent/current agent as the default long-horizon writer, with specialists acting as read-only gates and pathfinder retained only as explicit legacy opt-in.
OASIS RFC 2119 keyword guidelines
RFC 2119 keywords are written in uppercase and should be used sparingly for actual requirements; lowercase words keep ordinary English meaning.
Claude skill authoring best practices
Skill instructions should be concise, include only context the agent lacks, keep SKILL.md under roughly 500 lines, and move details into one-level references for progressive disclosure.

Skill authors should set low freedom through exact scripts when operations are fragile or consistency-critical, and prefer utility scripts for deterministic operations to reduce generated-code errors and token load.
Agent Skills best practices

Effective skills should be grounded in real project artifacts, omit generic explanations the agent already knows, use moderate detail, provide defaults instead of menus, and prefer reusable procedures over one-off answers.
Agent Skills optimizing descriptions

Skill descriptions should focus on user intent, be concise enough for metadata context, list realistic trigger contexts, and be tested with positive and near-miss negative prompts to avoid over- or under-triggering.
Agent Skills using scripts

Skill scripts should avoid interactive prompts, document --help usage, emit helpful errors, use structured stdout with diagnostics on stderr, be idempotent/retry-safe, support dry-run for stateful work, and keep output bounded.
skills/plan/SKILL.md current output and graph wording

The plan skill currently says to create or update primary plan artifacts and later to create plan.nodes.jsonl and plan.edges.jsonl, while also having a wrapper-first contract that prefers cartographer_plan and cartographer_plan_status.
skills/interview/SKILL.md current interview write wording

The interview skill currently instructs the parent writer to record answers in interview.md and upsert interview.nodes.jsonl/interview.edges.jsonl, so cleanup must either route those writes through dedicated tooling or explicitly document a fallback boundary.
skills/proposal/SKILL.md current output and research wording

The proposal skill already has a wrapper-first mutation contract but still contains legacy sections that tell agents to create or refine map/fact JSONL records directly and write findings one at a time.
package.json validation scripts
The project exposes npm run check, check:scripts, lint, format, typecheck, dashboard, and test scripts; skill cleanup can validate with existing commands plus targeted grep/script checks.
